class.name: waybionic_rviz_plugins/DiagnosticsPanel
class.description: WayBionic ground station diagnostics, telemetry, and alerts panel for RViz2.

class.name: waybionic_rviz_plugins/SetupPanel
class.description: Start-up steps for the arm: carrier, drives, controller, zero and ready, with a Zero button that asks the drive node to zero. This panel sends no motion commands.

class.name: waybionic_rviz_plugins/JointControlPanel
class.description: Switch arm joints on or off. The drive node holds a joint that is off; this panel sends no motion commands.

class.name: waybionic_rviz_plugins/MotionTestPanel
class.description: WayBionic visual robot motion testing panel.
